prerequisite: offset_alignment in segments (segments extended past the corner) + create_connected_alignment (offset segments as parent-line configuration)
assertions: data.ends_trimmed == 2 x number of corners (each corner trims both ends once)
after trimming, both end points of the corner remain exactly tangent on the segments (StationOffset offset = 0)
distance between the region end and the tangent point == margin (default 0.05)
degenerate input where a region is consumed entirely must be skipped and named, never silent
first_real_use: Trimming 48 corners in a secondary-channel design drawing (2026-08-23)
